Results.ReviewText: I like the grill set up with the 3 burners and the ignitor at the first burner.  The burners give good control and the grates are nice as is the inside higher-level warming rack.  I also like the shelf and the way the propane tank attaches to the grill.  I have not yet used a full tank so I am not sure how well the measuring system works but it's nice so far.  It was easy to assemble.  I was not able to get the Weber App to activate to give me the assembly video which was frustrating but the instruction manual included in the box was easy to understand.  I have the App but don't use it, it's not very helpful, hence 4 stars on the review.

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Spirit II E-310 has pleasantly worked as advertised.  The assembly directions were easy to follow and did not take long.  The heating start up is easy and all 3 burners light with the hood open as compared to other grills where you have to close the lid and let the gas build enough to light the remaining burners.  The grill grates work great for any meal being prepared as you have the ability to flip them over for a grill surface that matches whatever item you intend to cook.  The cooking is even everywhere; even with the burner settings on low with some wind in the area.  My wife and I have developed a habit of removing the grill grates, flavorizer bars, catch hood above the drip tray to clean them the next day after use.  We even clean out the burner box so that everything looks just about brand new for the next usage in order to prolong the grills life expectancy.  The coating on everything makes it easy to do this after everything cools down enough to work with.  I would reccommend this grill for anyone who wants a quality grill that tends to give you consistent results.  This is definetely a grill that gives you your moneys worth.
Results.Title: Money well spent

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
